approval.approvalContext: The authenticated user authorized exactly one new Seojin attack-animation planning unit. This decision reuses v10 as the sole current character identity, appearance, and equipment authority without changing characterSingleImage planning or appearance. It binds one verified official fast-preview PNG only as a reviewed visual reference, never as person identity, canonical identity, semantic clothing/equipment authority, or edit target. The attack continues from the approved right hand on the left-waist hwando hilt through one draw into one sword slash. All prior decisions, handoffs, routes, prompts, previews, records, and media remain immutable.

seojin.attack.allowed_vertical_motion.v1.value: none; preserve the support-foot ground axis across the draw, slash, and settle

seojin.attack.dark_neutral_ink_trajector.value: Use one bounded dark-neutral trajectory subordinate to the identity contour along the sword path and torso action axis; no arbitrary speed lines, aura, magic trail, or magic VFX.

value.policy: Preserve proportions, face, costume, equipment, sword and scabbard identity across all frames while poses evolve without duplication.

seojin.attack.hem_inertia.v11.value: The dusty gray-brown travel-robe hem lags the torso turn during the slash and settles after the sword arc, without becoming a separate effect.

value.pose: Draw initiation: right hand pulls the hwando from the left-waist scabbard, torso begins to rotate, support foot and compact 4-5-head body remain anchored.
Single slash apex: one continuous diagonal sword cut crosses the torso action axis; no second strike and no unrelated pose.
Follow-through settle: sword arc completes once, torso decelerates, shoulder armor and robe hem lag then settle while identity and equipment stay continuous.

seojin.attack.motion_direction.v11.value: One right-handed draw-to-slash motion travels from the left waist diagonally across the torso toward the upper right, then decelerates into follow-through.

value: Do not create move, idle, eight-way, rotation, pose-list, variant, or more than one attack animation.
Do not use arbitrary speed lines, decorative motion streaks, aura, magic trail, or magic VFX.
Do not use clean-vector, uniform closed-outline, coloring-book, photorealistic, 3D, PBR, or glossy cinematic treatment.
Do not add armor plates, scales, rivets, lacing, fasteners, garment microfolds, or material microtexture.
Do not drift body proportions, face, low topknot, costume layers, one-shoulder armor, hand-to-sword relation, hwando structure, scabbard side, support foot, or action joints.
Do not treat the reviewed fast-preview PNG as person identity, canonical identity, clothing/equipment authority, or edit target.
Show exactly one right-handed attack continuing from the draw at the left waist into one sword slash and follow-through.
Maintain the 4.0-5.0-head compact young-adult Korean male body, calm face, low Joseon topknot, Joseon clothing, simplified one-shoulder armor, hwando and scabbard continuously across all frames.
Use open and broken pressure-variable ink lines with broad rough watercolor and pastel bleed and generous negative space.
Integrate three to five faded-indigo directional brush marks with the approved sword arc and torso rotation in each active attack frame.
Use subordinate dusty gray-brown shoulder and hem lag followed by settlement in the approved key-pose order.
Use a bounded dark-neutral sword-path and torso-axis trajectory subordinate to identity contours.
Keep armor as one simplified shoulder mass without plate-level microdetail.
Keep every frame on the same fixed canvas, scale, pelvis/root point, and ground-contact axis.

seojin.attack.scale_lock.v11.value: constant subject scale, fixed 1024x1536 cell, no per-frame crop, rescale, silhouette recenter, or canvas change

seojin.attack.shoulder_inertia.v11.value: The dusty gray-brown one-shoulder armor mass lags the torso rotation by one ordered pose phase and settles in follow-through without plate microdetail.

seojin.attack.sword_arc.v11.value: A single continuous diagonal hwando arc begins at the left-waist draw, crosses the front of the torso, reaches one upper-right apex, and ends in one bounded follow-through.

seojin.attack.torso_rotation.v11.value: Torso rotates progressively with the draw and slash, reaches maximum rotation at the slash apex, then decelerates without reversing into a second attack.
